Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-screen video game scene, original postapocalyptic action comic.
Primary request: the player's first-person eye-level view standing at a junction, looking ahead at 1 available route(s), no people or bodies visible. World: civilians surviving against autonomous machines. Setting: underground service tunnels, reinforced concrete, overhead pipes, abandoned subway utilities, cyan practical lights.
Style reference image only: keep the thick confident black comic inks, crisp angular cel shading, subtle print halftone, vivid aubergine/cyan/rust-orange colors and the same original industrial world. NO pencil sketchbook, NO medieval fantasy.
Composition: wide landscape 16:9, exactly ONE clear straight passage, entrance centered at 47 percent of image width. Each passage leads convincingly into depth, with visible walkable floor starting at the bottom center. Doors are tall and readable; do not put small doors on far-off walls. All route entrances within LEFT 90 percent of picture; reserve the rightmost 8 percent as an uncluttered dark wall for a navigation rail. Upper 12 percent and lower 16 percent have quieter drawing for runtime labels. Clear distinct route mouth centered vertically at 48 percent image height. No other accessible doors, branching side streets or extra exits. No lettering, arrows, room icons, interface, sign text, people, hands, heads, heroes, monsters, chests. The game overlays the correct destination icons dynamically. Full bleed finished comic illustration, opaque background, horizontal 1536x864 composition.
